paragraphs.source_en: After the Kiyosu Conference, Hideyoshi installed Hidemasa at Sawayama Castle, formerly held by Niwa Nagahide, and made him a lord of two hundred thousand koku. paragraphs.source_en: Hidemasa felt that he might somehow catch sight of Hideyoshi, and so he reined in his horse and stopped. This castle was itself a symbol of Hideyoshi's display of power to the Oda retainers led by Katsuie: Come, all of you, and behold—this is the strength and wisdom of Hideyoshi.

units.source_en: Hidemasa felt that he might somehow catch sight of Hideyoshi, and so he reined in his horse and stopped.
units.source_zh: 秀政总觉得能在什么地方看见秀吉的身影，于是把马勒住，停了下来。

units.source_en: This castle was itself a symbol of Hideyoshi's display of power to the Oda retainers led by Katsuie: Come, all of you, and behold—this is the strength and wisdom of Hideyoshi.
units.source_zh: 这座城原本就是秀吉向以胜家为首的织田氏家臣们示威的象征——大家都来看看，这就是我秀吉的实力和智慧。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀政总觉得能在什么地方看见秀吉的身影，于是把马勒住，停了下来。这座城原本就是秀吉向以胜家为首的织田氏家臣们示威的象征——大家都来看看，这就是我秀吉的实力和智慧。

paragraphs.source_en: If that was truly so, then Katsuie had fallen into an enormous trap. Hidemasa could not help murmuring to himself, “Dangerous—far too dangerous.”

units.source_en: If that was truly so, then Katsuie had fallen into an enormous trap.

ja.t: にはまったことになる。

units.source_zh: 如果真是这样，胜家可就上了大当了。

units.source_en: Hidemasa could not help murmuring to himself, “Dangerous—far too dangerous.”
units.source_zh: 秀政不禁自言自语：“危险，太危险了。”
